verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe saying:

verses.he: מַלֵּיל עִם בְּנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמֵימַר אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי תְעַדִּי וּתְלִיד דְּכָר וּתְהֵי מְסָאָבָא שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין כְּיוֹמֵי רִחוּק סוֹבְתַהּ תְּהֵי מְסָאָבָא:
verses.en: Speak to Bnei Yisroel, saying, when a woman conceives and gives birth to a male child she will be ritually unclean for seven days; as the days of her menstrual flow [the state of her impure ‘separation’], she will be unclean.

verses.he: וּבְיוֹמָא תְּמִינָאָה יִגְזַר בִּסְרָא דְעָרְלְתֵיהּ:
verses.en: On the eighth day, the flesh of his foreskin shall be circumcised.

verses.he: וּתְלָתִין וּתְלָתָא יוֹמִין תֵּיתֵב בְּדַם דְּכוּ בְּכָל קוּדְשָׁא לָא תִקְרַב וּלְמִקְדְּשָׁא לָא תֵעוֹל עַד מִשְׁלַם יוֹמֵי דָכוּתַהּ:
verses.en: For thirty-three days she will remain [in the status] that the blood [she sees] is ritually pure. She shall not touch anything holy and she shall not come into the Sanctuary, until the days of her purity are completed.

verses.he: וְאִם נְקוּבְתָא תְלִיד וּתְהֵי מְסָאָבָא אַרְבְּעָה עֲסַר כְּרִחוּקַהּ וְשִׁתִּין וְשִׁתָּא יוֹמִין תֵּיתֵב עַל דַּם דְּכוּ:
verses.en: If she gives birth to a female she will be unclean for two weeks [fourteen days] as during her menstruation [‘separation’]. For sixty-six days she will remain [in the status] that the blood [she sees] is ritually pure.

verses.he: וּבְמִשְׁלַם יוֹמֵי דָכוּתַהּ לִבְרָא אוֹ לִבְרַתָּא תַּיְתִי אִמָּר בַּר שַׁתֵּיהּ לַעֲלָתָא וּבַר יוֹנָה אוֹ שַׁפְנִינָא לְחַטָּאתָא לִתְרַע מַשְׁכַּן זִמְנָא לְוָת כַּהֲנָא:
verses.en: When the days of her purification are completed, be it for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a lamb, in its first year, as a burnt-offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove as a sin-offering, to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting, to the kohein.

verses.he: וִיקָרְבִנֵּיהּ קֳדָם יְיָ וִיכַפֵּר עֲלַהּ וְתִדְכֵּי מִסּוֹאֲבַת דְּמָהָא דָּא אוֹרַיְתָא דְיַלֶּדְתָּא לְדוּכְרָא אוֹ לִנְקֻבְתָא:
verses.en: He will bring it before Adonoy and atone for her and she will be cleansed from the source [impurity] of her blood; this is the law regarding the woman who gives birth to a male or to a female.

verses.he: וְאִם לָא תַשְׁכַּח יְדַהּ כְּמִסַּת אִמְּרָא וְתִסַּב תַּרְתֵּין שַׁפְנִינִין אוֹ תְרֵין בְּנֵי יוֹנָה חַד לַעֲלָתָא וְחַד לְחַטָּאתָא וִיכַפֵּר עֲלַהּ כַּהֲנָא וְתִדְכֵּי:
verses.en: If she cannot afford [to acquire] a lamb she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons; one as a burnt-offering and one as a sin-offering. The kohein will atone for her and she will be cleansed.

verses.he: וּמַלִּיל יְיָ עִם משֶׁה וְעִם אַהֲרֹן לְמֵימָר:
verses.en: Adonoy spoke to Moshe and to Aharon, saying:

verses.he: אֱנַשׁ אֲרֵי יְהֵי בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרֵיהּ עַמְקָא אוֹ עַדְיָא אוֹ בַהֲרָא וִיהֵי בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרֵיהּ לְמַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּ וְיִתֵּתֵי לְוָת אַהֲרֹן כַּהֲנָא אוֹ לְוָת חַד מִבְּנוֹהִי כָּהֲנַיָּא:
verses.en: When a person will have, in the skin of his flesh a spot of intense [deep] whiteness or an off-white spot, or a snow-white spot, and it forms on the skin of his body [like] the plague of tzoraas, [‘confinement’] he shall be brought to Aharon, the kohein, or to one of his sons, the kohanim.

verses.he: וֶיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרָא וְשֵׂעָר בְּמַכְתָּשָׁא אִתְהֲפִיךְ לְמֶחֱוָר וּמֶחֱזֵי מַכְתָּשָׁא עַמִּיק בִּמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרֵיהּ מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּתָא הוּא וְיֶחֱזִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא וִיסָאֵב יָתֵיהּ:
verses.en: The kohein shall see the plague in the skin of the flesh and [if] the hair in the skin-eruption has turned white and the appearance of the plague is deeper than the skin of his body, it is the skin-eruption of tzoraas. [‘confinement’] The kohein shall see it and declare him [to be] unclean.

verses.he: וְאִם בַּהֲרָא חַוְּרָא הִיא בִּמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרֵיהּ וְעַמִּיק לֵית מֶחֱזָהָא מִן מַשְׁכָא וּשְׂעָרָא לָא אִתְהֲפִיךְ לְמֶחֱוָר וְיַסְגַּר כַּהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין:
verses.en: If it is a snow-white spot in the skin of the flesh and it does not appear deeper than the skin and the hair did not turn white, the kohein shall confine the plague for seven days.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה וְהָא מַכְתְּשָׁא קָם כַּד הֲוָה לָא אוֹסֵף מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וְיַסְגְּרִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין תִּנְיָנוּת:
verses.en: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day and behold! [if] the skin-eruption has maintained its hue [remained as it was]; the skin-eruption did not spread [increase] in the skin. The kohein shall confine him for seven days, a second time,

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָתֵיהּ בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה תִּנְיָנוּת וְהָא עַמְיָא מַכְתָּשָׁא וְלָא אוֹסֵף מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וִידַכִּנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא עֲדִיתָא הִיא וִיצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיִדְכֵּי:
verses.en: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day for the second time and behold! [if] the skin-eruption became dimmer and the skin-eruption did not spread [increase] in the skin, the kohein shall declare him [to be] clean; it is [merely] a [removed] white discoloration. He shall wash his garments and he will be cleansed.

verses.he: וְאִם אוֹסָפָא תוֹסֵף עֲדִיתָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא בָּתַר דִּאִתַּחֲזִי לְכַהֲנָא לְדַכּוּתֵיהּ וְיִתַּחֲזִי תִנְיָנוּת לְכַהֲנָא:
verses.en: If the [removed] white discoloration has spread [increased] in the skin after it was shown to the kohein, who pronounced that it was clean, it must be shown a second time to the kohein.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא אוֹסֵפַת עֲדִיתָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וִיסָאֵבִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא סְגִירוּתָא הִיא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see and behold! [if] the [removed] white discoloration has spread [increased] in the skin, the kohein shall declare him unclean, it is tzoraas. [‘confinement’]

verses.he: מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּ אֲרֵי תְהֵי בֶּאֱנָשָׁא וְיִתֵּתֵי לְוָת כַּהֲנָא:
verses.en: When there is a skin-eruption of tzoraas [‘confinement’] on a person he shall be brought to the kohein.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא עַמְקָא חַוְּרָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וְהִיא הֲפָכַת שֵׂעָר לְחִוָּר וְרשֶׁם בִּסְרָא חַיְתָא בְּעַמִּקְתָּא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see and behold! there is an intensely [deep] white spot on the skin and it has turned the hair white or there is [an impression of] healthy flesh in the spot of intense [deep] whiteness,

verses.he: סְגִירוּת עַתִּיקָא הִיא בִּמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרֵיהּ וִיסָאֵבִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא לָא יַסְגְּרִנֵיהּ אֲרֵי מְסָאָב הוּא:
verses.en: it is an old tzoraas [‘confinement’] in the skin of his body and the kohein shall declare him unclean he shall not confine him, since he is [obviously] unclean.

verses.he: וְאִם מִסְגָּא תִסְגֵּי סְגִירוּתָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וְתַחֲפֵי סְגִירוּתָא יָת כָּל מְשַׁךְ מַכְתָּשָׁא מֵרֵישֵׁיהּ וְעַד רַגְלוֹהִי לְכָל חֵיזוּ עֵינֵי כַהֲנָא:
verses.en: And if the tzoraas [‘confinement’] sprouts on the skin and if the tzoraas [‘confinement’] covered the entire skin of the [one affected by] the eruption from his head until his feet to the extent that the kohein can see.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא חֲפַת סְגִירוּתָא יָת כָּל בִּסְרֵיהּ וִידַכִּי יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא כֻּלֵּיהּ אִתְהֲפִיךְ לְמֶחֱוַר דְּכֵי הוּא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see and behold! the tzoraas [‘confinement’] has covered all of his body, he shall declare the skin-eruption to be cleansed, it has turned completely white, he is clean.

verses.he: וּבְיוֹמָא דְאִתַּחֲזִי בֵיהּ בִּסְרָא חַיָּא יְהֵי מְסָאָב:
verses.en: On the day that healthy flesh appears on him, he will become unclean.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת בִּסְרָא חַיָּא וִיסָאֵבִנֵּיהּ בִּסְרָא חַיָּא מְסָאָב הוּא סְגִירוּת הוּא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see the healthy flesh and declare him unclean. The healthy flesh is unclean, it is tzoraas. [‘confinement’]

verses.he: אוֹ אֲרֵי יְתוּב בִּסְרָא חַיָּא וְיִתְהֲפִיךְ לְמֶחֱוָר וְיִתֵּתֵי לְוָת כַּהֲנָא:
verses.en: Or, if the healthy flesh turns again and it was changed to white, he shall come [be brought] to the kohein.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא וְהָא אִתְהֲפִיךְ מַכְתָּשָׁא לְמֶחֱוָר וִידַכֵּי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא דְּכֵי הוּא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see him, and behold! the skin-eruption has turned white; the kohein shall declare the skin-eruption to be clean, he is clean.

verses.he: וּבִסְרָא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בֵיהּ בְּמַשְׁכֵּיהּ שִׁחֲנָא וְיִתַּסֵּי:
verses.en: When a person has on his skin an inflammation that has healed.

verses.he: וִיהֵי בַּאֲתַר שִׁחֲנָא עַמְקָא חַוְּרָא אוֹ בַהֲרָא חַוְּרָא סַמְקָא וְיִתַּחֲזִי לְכַהֲנָא:
verses.en: If there was on the area of the inflammation a spot of intense [deep] whiteness or a snow-white spot tinged with red it shall be shown to the kohein.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא מֶחֱזָהָא מַכִּיךְ מִן מַשְׁכָּא וּשְׂעָרַהּ אִתְהֲפִיךְ לְמֶחֱוָר וִיסָאֵבִינֵיהּ כַּהֲנָא מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּתָא הִיא בְּשִׁחֲנָא סְגִיאַת:
verses.en: The kohein shall see it and behold! its appearance is lower than the skin, and its hair has turned white, the kohein shall declare him unclean; It is the skin-eruption of tzoraas [‘confinement’] that has sprouted through the inflammation.

verses.he: וְאִם יֶחֱזִנַּהּ כַּהֲנָא וְהָא לֵית בַּהּ שֵׂעָר חִוָּר וּמַכִּיכָא לֵיתָהָא מִן מַשְׁכָּא וְהִיא עָמְיָא וְיַסְגְּרִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין:
verses.en: If the kohein looks at it and behold! there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin and it is faint, the kohein shall confine him for seven days.

verses.he: וְאִם אוֹסָפָא תוֹסֵף בְּמַשְׁכָּא וִיסָאֵב כַּהֲנָא יָתֵיהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא הִיא:
verses.en: If it spread [increased] in the skin, the kohein shall declare him unclean, it is a skin eruption.

verses.he: וְאִם בְּאַתְרָהָא קָמַת בֶּהַרְתָּא לָא אוֹסֵפַת רשֶׁם שִׁחֲנָא הִיא וִידַכִּנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא:
verses.en: If the snow-white spot remains in its place and it did not spread [increase], it is [merely] a scar [an impression] of the inflammation and the kohein shall declare him clean.

verses.he: אוֹ בִסְרָא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בְמַשְׁכֵּיהּ כְּוָאָה דְנוּר וּתְהֵי רשֶׁם כְּוָאָה בַּהֲרָא חַוְּרָא סַמְקָא אוֹ חַוְּרָא:
verses.en: When a person has on his skin a burn from a fire and [on] the healthy flesh [impression] of the burnt part, came a snow-white spot tinged with red or pure white spot.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי יָתַהּ כַּהֲנָא וְהָא אִתְהֲפִיךְ שֵׂעָר חִוָּר בְּבַהֶרְתָּא וּמֶחֱזָהָא עַמִּיק מִן מַשְׁכָּא סְגִירוּתָא הִיא בִּכְוָאָה סְגִיאָה וִיסָאֵב יָתֵיהּ כַּהֲנָא מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּתָא הִיא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see it and behold! the hair has turned white in the snow-white spot and its appearance is deeper than the skin; it is tzoraas [‘confinement’] that has sprouted in the burn. The kohein shall declare him unclean, it is the skin-eruption of tzoraas. [‘confinement’]

verses.he: וְאִם יֶחֱזִנַּהּ כַּהֲנָא וְהָא לֵית בְּבַהֶרְתָּא שֵׂעָר חִוָּר וּמַכִּיכָא לֵיתָהָא מִן מַשְׁכָּא וְהִיא עָמְיָא וְיַסגְּרִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין:
verses.en: If the kohein shall see it, and behold! there is not, in the snow-white spot, any white hair and it is not lower than the skin, and it is faint. The kohein shall confine him for seven days.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה אִם אוֹסָפָא תוֹסֵף בְּמַשְׁכָּא וִיסָאֵב כַּהֲנָא יָתֵיהּ מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּתָא הִיא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see him on the seventh day. If it has spread [increased] in the skin, the kohein shall declare him unclean, it is the skin-eruption of tzoraas. [‘confinement’]

verses.he: וְאִם בְּאַתְרָהָא קָמַת בַּהֶרְתָּא לָא אוֹסֵפַת בְּמַשְׁכָּא וְהִיא עָמְיָא עֹמֶק כְּוָאָה הִיא וִידַכִּנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא אֲרֵי רשֶׁם כְּוָאָה הִיא:
verses.en: If the snow-white spot remains in its place and it did not spread [increase] in the skin and it is faint, it is the [deep] white spot of the burn. The kohein shall declare him clean for it is [merely] the scar [impression] of the burn.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אוֹ אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בֵיהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּרֵישָׁא אוֹ בִדְקָן:
verses.en: If a man or a woman will have a skin-eruption on the head or in the beard.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא וְהָא מֶחֱזוֹהִי עַמִּיק מִן מַשְׁכָּא וּבֵיהּ שֵׂעָר סֻמָּק דַּעְדָּק וִיסָאֵב יָתֵיהּ כַּהֲנָא נִתְקָא הוּא סְגִירוּת רֵישָׁא אוֹ דִקְנָא הוּא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see the skin-eruption, and behold! its appearance is deeper than the skin and there is thin golden [reddish] hair in it. The kohein shall pronounce it unclean, It is a nesek, it is tzoraas [‘confinement’] of the head or the beard.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי יֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתַּשׁ נִתְקָא וְהָא לֵית מֶחֱזוֹהִי עַמִּיק מִן מַשְׁכָּא וְשֵׂעָר אֻכָּם לֵית בֵּיהּ וְיַסְגַּר כַּהֲנָא יָת מַכְתַּשׁ נִתְקָא שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין:
verses.en: When the kohein will see the skin eruption of nesek—and behold! it does not appear deeper than the skin and there is no black hair in it, the kohein shall confine [the one affected by] the skin-eruption of the nesek for seven days.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה וְהָא לָא אוֹסֵף נִתְקָא וְלָא הֲוָה בֵיהּ שֵׂעָר סֻמָּק וּמֶחֱזֵי נִתְקָא לֵית עַמִּיק מִן מַשְׁכָּא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see the skin-eruption on the seventh day, and behold! the nesek did not spread [increase] and there was no golden [reddish] hair in it and the appearance of the nesek is not deeper than the skin.

verses.he: וִיגַלַּח סָחֳרָנֵי נִתְקָא וּדְעִם נִתְקָא לָא יְגַלַּח וְיַסְגַּר כַּהֲנָא יָת נִתְקָא שִׁבְעָא יוֹמִין תִּנְיָנוּת:
verses.en: He shall be shaved [shave around the nesek] but he shall not shave [close to] the nesek, and the kohein shall confine the nesek for a second seven day period.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת נִתְקָא בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה וְהָא לָא אוֹסֵף נִתְקָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא וּמֶחֱזוֹהִי לֵיתוֹהִי עַמִּיק מִן מַשְׁכָּא וִידַכֵּי יָתֵיהּ כַּהֲנָא וִיצַבַּע לְבוּשׁוֹהִי וְיִדְכֵּי:
verses.en: The kohein shall see the nesek on the seventh day and behold! if the nesek did not spread [increase] in the skin and its appearance is not deeper than the skin. The kohein shall declare him clean. He shall wash his garments and he will be clean.

verses.he: וְאִם אוֹסָפָא יוֹסֵף נִתְקָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא בָּתַר דָּכוּתֵיהּ:
verses.en: If the nesek spreads [increases] [extensively] in the skin after he is pronounced clean,

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא וְהָא אוֹסֵף נִתְקָא בְּמַשְׁכָּא לָא יְבַקֵּר כַּהֲנָא לְשֵׂעָר סֻמָּק מְסָאָב הוּא:
verses.en: the kohein shall see him and behold! the nesek has spread [increased] in the skin. The kohein shall not [even] look for golden [reddish] hair, he is unclean.

verses.he: וְאִם כַּד הֲוָה קָם נִתְקָא וְשֵׂעָר אֻכָּם צְמַח בֵּיהּ אִתַּסִּי נִתְקָא דְּכֵי הוּא וִידַכִּנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא:
verses.en: If the nesek remained the same as it was and black hair grew in it, the nesek is healed, he is clean, and the kohein shall declare him clean.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אוֹ אִתְּתָא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרְהוֹן בַּהֲרָן בַּהֲרָן חַוְּרָן:
verses.en: When a man or a woman have in the skin of their flesh—white spots.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא בִמְשַׁךְ בִּסְרְהוֹן בַּהֲרָן עָמְיָן חַוְּרָן בָּהֲקָא הוּא סָגֵי בְמַשְׁכָּא דְּכֵי הוּא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see, and behold! in the skin of their flesh are dim white spots, it is [merely] scurf that has sprouted in the skin; it is clean.

verses.he: וּגְבַר אֲרֵי יַתַּר שְׂעַר רֵישֵׁיהּ קְרַח הוּא דְּכֵי הוּא:
verses.en: If a mans hair falls out, he is [merely] bald; he is clean.

verses.he: וְאִם מִלָּקֳבֵל אֲפּוֹהִי יַתַּר שְׂעַר רֵישֵׁיהּ גְּלוֹשׁ הוּא דְּכֵי הוּא:
verses.en: If, on the front of his head his hair falls out, he is [merely] frontally bald; he is clean.

verses.he: וַאֲרֵי יְהֵי בְקָרָחוּתֵיהּ אוֹ בִגְלוֹשׁוּתֵיהּ מַכְתַּשׁ חִוָּר סַמּוֹק סְגִירוּת סָגְיָא הִיא בְּקָרָחוּתֵיהּ אוֹ בִגְלוֹשׁוּתֵיהּ:
verses.en: If there will be, in the baldness in back of the head or in the baldness in front of the head a white skin-eruption, tinged with red, it is tzoraas [‘confinement’] sprouting in his frontal baldness or in his posterior baldness.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי יָתֵיהּ כַּהֲנָא וְהָא עַמִּיק מַכְתָּשָׁא חַוְּרָא סַמְּקָא בְּקָרָחוּתֵיהּ אוֹ בִגְלוֹשׁוּתֵיהּ כְּמֶחֱזֵי סְגִירוּתָא מְשַׁךְ בִּסְרָא:
verses.en: The kohein shall see him, and behold! the spot of intense [deep] whiteness is tinged with red in his frontal baldness or in his posterior baldness just as the appearance tzoraas [‘confinement’] of the skin of the flesh.

verses.he: גְּבַר סְגִיר הוּא מְסָאָב הוּא סָאֳבָא יְסָאֵבִנֵּיהּ כַּהֲנָא בְּרֵישֵׁיהּ מַכְתָּשֵׁיהּ:
verses.en: He is a person with tzoraas, [‘confinement’] he is unclean. The kohein shall declare him unclean; his skin-eruption is on his head.

verses.he: וּסְגִירָא דִּי בֵיהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא לְבוּשׁוֹהִי יְהוֹן מְבַזְּעִין וְרֵישֵׁיהּ יְהֵי פְרִיעַ וְעַל שָׂפָם כַּאֲבֵלָא יִתְעַטָּף וְלָא תִסְתַּאֲבוּן וְלָא תִסְתַּאֲבוּן יִקְרֵי:
verses.en: The tzorua [one who is ‘confined’]—[the person] who has the skin-eruption—his garments shall have a tear in them, his hair shall be grown long, and he must cover his head down to his upper lip [like a mourner], and [do not become] Unclean, [do not become] unclean, shall he call out.

verses.he: כָּל יוֹמֵי דִּי מַכְתָּשָׁא בֵיהּ יְהֵי מְסָאָב מְסָאָב הוּא בִּלְחוֹדוֹהִי יֵיתֵב מִבָּרָא לְמַשְׁרִיתָא מוֹתְבֵיהּ:
verses.en: All the days in which the skin-eruption is on him he shall be unclean; he is unclean. He shall dwell alone; his dwelling shall be beyond the encampment.

verses.he: וּלְבוּשָׁא אֲרֵי יְהֵי בֵיהּ מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּ בִּלְבוּשׁ עֲמַר אוֹ בִּלְבוּשׁ כִּתָּן:
verses.en: When in a garment there is a skin-eruption of tzoraas, [‘confinement’] whether a woolen garment or in a linen garment.

verses.he: אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא לְכִתָּנָא וּלְעַמְרָא אוֹ בְמַשְׁכָּא אוֹ בְּכָל עֲבִידַת מְשָׁךְ:
verses.en: Or if it is the warp [lengthwise] threads, or in the woof [widthwise] threads, in a linen garment, or a woolen garment, or on leather or in any object made of leather.

verses.he: וִיהֵי מַכְתָּשָׁא יָרוֹק אוֹ סַמּוֹק בִּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ בְמַשְׁכָּא אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא אוֹ בְכָל מַאן דִּמְשַׁךְ מַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּתָא הוּא וְיִתַּחֲזֵי לְכַהֲנָא:
verses.en: If the plague is deep green or deep red [green or red], in the garment, or in the leather hide or in the warp threads, or in the woof threads, or if it is in any object made of leather; it is the eruption of tzoraas [‘confinement’] and it shall be shown to the kohein.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא וְיַסְגַּר יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין:
verses.en: The kohein shall see the plague and confine the eruption, for seven days.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא בְּיוֹמָא שְׁבִיעָאָה אֲרֵי אוֹסֵף מַכְתָּשָׁא בִּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא אוֹ בְמַשְׁכָּא לְכֹל דִּי יִתְעֲבֵד מַשְׁכָּא לְעִבִידָא סְגִירוּת מְחַסְרָא מַכְתָּשָׁא מְסָאָב הוּא:
verses.en: He shall see the eruption on the seventh day. If the eruption has spread [increased] in the garment or in the warp thread, or in the woof thread, or in the leather hide, or in the work made of leather, it is a prickly tzoraas, [‘confinement’ of loss] it is unclean.

verses.he: וְיוֹקִיד יָת לְבוּשָׁא אוֹ יָת שִׁתְיָא אוֹ יָת עַרְבָא בְּעַמְרָא אוֹ בְכִתָּנָא אוֹ יָת כָּל מָאן דִּמְשַׁךְ דִּי יְהֵי בֵיהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא אֲרֵי סְגִירוּת מְחַסְרָא הִיא בְּנוּרָא תִּתּוֹקָד:
verses.en: He shall burn the garment, or the warp [lengthwise] threads, or the woof [widthwise] threads, be it in wool or in linen, or in all leather made objects, in which there is the eruption. For it is a prickly tzoraas. [‘confinement’ of loss] It shall be burned in fire.

verses.he: וְאִם יֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא וְהָא לָא אוֹסֵף מַכְתָּשָׁא בִּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא אוֹ בְּכָל מָאן דִּמְשָׁךְ:
verses.en: If the kohein will see, and behold! the eruption did not spread [increase] in the garment, or in the warp threads, or in the woof threads, or in any leather made object.

verses.he: וִיפַקֵּד כַּהֲנָא וִיחַוְּרוּן יָת דִּי בֵיהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא וְיַסְגְּרִנֵּיהּ שִׁבְעַת יוֹמִין תִּנְיָנוּת:
verses.en: The kohein shall command that they shall wash the article having the eruption, and confine it for seven days, a second time.

verses.he: וְיֶחֱזֵי כַהֲנָא בָּתַר דְּחַוָּרוּ יָת מַכְתָּשָׁא וְהָא לָא שְׁנָא מַכְתָּשָׁא מִן כַּד הֲוָה וּמַכְתָּשָׁא לָא אוֹסֵף מְסָאָב הוּא בְּנוּרָא תּוֹקְדִנֵּיהּ תַּבְרָא הִיא בְּשְׁחִיקוּתֵיהּ אוֹ בְחַדָּתוּתֵיהּ:
verses.en: The kohein shall see it after the eruption was washed and behold! [even if] the eruption did not change its hue [from what it was] and the eruption did not spread [increase]; it is unclean, you shall burn it in fire. It is a deep mark [break] be it in a worn [garment] or in a new [garment].

verses.he: וְאִם חֲזָא כַהֲנָא וְהָא עָמְיָא מַכְתָּשָׁא בָּתַר דְּחַוָּרוּ יָתֵיהּ וּבְזַע יָתֵיהּ מִן לְבוּשָׁא אוֹ מִן מַשְׁכָּא אוֹ מִן שִׁתְיָא אוֹ מִן עַרְבָא:
verses.en: If the kohein saw and behold! the eruption grew faint after it was washed; he shall tear it from the garment, or from the leather, or from the warp threads or from the woof threads.

verses.he: וְאִם תִּתְחֲזֵי עוֹד בִּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ בְשִׁתְיָא אוֹ בְעַרְבָא אוֹ בְכָל מָאן דִּמְשַׁךְ סָגְיָא הִיא בְּנוּרָא תוֹקְדִנֵּיהּ יָת דִּי בֵיהּ מַכְתָּשָׁא:
verses.en: If it will appear again, in the garment or in the warp [lengthwise] threads, or in the woof [widthwise] threads, or in any leather-made object, it is a recurrent outbreak of tzoraas. You shall burn the article having the eruption in fire.

verses.he: וּלְבוּשָׁא אוֹ שִׁתְיָא אוֹ עַרְבָא אוֹ כָל מָאן דִּמְשַׁךְ דִּי יִתְחַוַּר וְיֶעְדֵּי מִנְּהוֹן מַכְתָּשָׁא וְיִצְטַבַּע תִּנְיָנוּת וְיִדְכֵּי:
verses.en: The garment, or the warp threads, or the woof threads, or any leather objects that were washed and the eruption disappears from them, it shall be washed a second time and it shall be purified.

verses.he: דָּא אוֹרַיְתָא דְמַכְתַּשׁ סְגִירוּ בִּלְבוּשׁ עֲמַר אוֹ כִתָּנָא אוֹ שִׁתְיָא אוֹ עַרְבָא אוֹ כָּל מָאן דִּמְשָׁךְ לְדַכָּיוּתֵיהּ אוֹ לְסַאֲבוּתֵיהּ:
verses.en: This is the law of the eruption of tzoraas [‘confinement’] be it in a woolen garment, or a linen garment, or in the warp [lengthwise] thread, or in the woof [widthwise] thread, or in any leather-made object, that it be pronounced pure, or that it be pronounced impure.
